description:
Several call sites do:
```rust
args["update"] = serde_json::to_value(&u).map_err(|e| {
    jmap_base_client::ClientError::InvalidArgument(
        format!("...: serializing update map failed: {e}"))
})?;
```
where `u: HashMap<Id, PatchObject>`. `Id` is `#[serde(transparent)]` over
String and `PatchObject` is `#[serde(transparent)]` over
`Map<String, Value>`. The combination is infallible to convert to
`serde_json::Value` — there is no condition under which `to_value` can
return Err for these inputs. The .map_err branch is dead code.

Affected sites (non-exhaustive):
  - email.rs:122-126 (email_set update)
  - email.rs:268-272 (email_import emails_value)
  - identity.rs:91-95 (identity_set update)
  - mailbox.rs:102-106 (mailbox_set update)
  - submission.rs:176-181 (email_submission_set onSuccessUpdateEmail)
  - submission.rs:195-199 (email_submission_set update)
  - vacation.rs:63-67 (vacation_response_set update)

The map_err branches for `serde_json::to_value(p)` on params structs that
contain `Option<Vec<String>>` or `Option<bool>` etc. are ALSO dead — those
are all infallible. The only currently-fallible path through the typed API
would be a user-defined type with a Serialize impl that panics or returns
Err (e.g. via #[serde(serialize_with = ...)] with a function that
fails). None of those exist here.

Fix: replace with `.expect("HashMap<Id, PatchObject> Serialize is
infallible")` matching the existing pattern at email.rs:42, 129, etc.
("Id slice Serialize is infallible").

Net effect: removes ~50 lines of dead error-path boilerplate and keeps the
style consistent across the crate.
title: Dead error-mapping branches: serde_json::to_value(<infallible types>).map_err(...)
